purpose: Bounded source/contract anchored checks for graph identity and digest meaning

input.invocation_bound: whether the graph invocation is bound to exact target SHA/tree
input.semantic_name: observed semantic label compared with contract semantic_name

finding_codes.SCOPE_TOO_NARROW: Required repository/target/config identity scope is omitted
finding_codes.SCOPE_TOO_BROAD: Volatile invocation or command fields are included in identity/digest scope
finding_codes.STATIC_AS_RUNTIME: Static source or index evidence is labelled as runtime state
finding_codes.INVOCATION_NOT_BOUND: Graph invocation lacks exact target SHA/tree binding
finding_codes.IDENTITY_DIGEST_CONFLATION: Identity and content/observation digest share a field or value
finding_codes.SEMANTIC_NAME_MISMATCH: Observed semantic name differs from the contract or static evidence meaning

invariants: Caller-supplied codegraph_admitted is never read as authority
An analyzer finding is diagnostic evidence and cannot grant Product or runtime admission
A coherent source- and contract-anchored identity can produce an empty finding list
Findings are deterministic and ordered by check category
Missing or unresolved graph evidence is not silently promoted to runtime truth
non_goals: Graphify or CodeGraph as an independent authority
